name: expo-config-native
title: Expo config
description: app.config.ts: the URL scheme for auth deep links, secure session storage and push, on top of app.json.
docs: Set `scheme` in `app.json` to your app's scheme; magic links and OAuth redirect to it, and `handleAuthDeepLink` from `better-supabase/client/native` finishes the sign-in. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/frameworks/expo.
